countInfo.Council_Name: Newry No. 1 (County Down) Rural District Council

source.title: Irish News, 7 June 1952, p. 5 ("Rural council election results"); Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations"); Newry Reporter, 12 June 1952, p. 4 ("Notice of Result of Elections - Newry No. 1 Rural Council"); Frontier Sentinel, 14 June 1952, p. 3 ("Rural District Council election results")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes read on the page image of the Returning Officer's notice (Newry Reporter, 12 June 1952, p. 4) and the Frontier Sentinel results (Frontier Sentinel, 14 June 1952, p. 3): Fegan 179, Murphy 49

note: Triennial election of the 14 electoral divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Hilltown was the only division contested; no nomination was received for Glen, whose retiring member was deemed to be re-elected. Murphy was the outgoing member.
